created_by: Spring (Forge job, Ken approved Runway take goblin-grunt-death Oct 28)
request: Snotskull Grunt (goblin-grunt): a scrappy goblin foot soldier with a rusty helmet and purple rags; he holds a wooden board in his right hand. REFERENCE VIDEO: the owner had Runway make one 6 s FRONT-view death video and APPROVED both halves. Its frames are in refs/ (Read the pictures with the Read tool): refs/goblin-grunt--front.jpg is his model from the front; refs/goblin-grunt-death/frames/fall-over/f01..f12.jpg is part 1 (0-3 s) and refs/goblin-grunt-death/frames/lying-still/f01..f12.jpg is part 2 (3-6 s), 12 evenly spaced frames per 3 s, time order. FIRST look at all the pictures, then match his BODY and LIMB poses frame by frame: the dizzy wobble, knees buckling, sitting down onto his bottom, then tumbling back onto his back, and lying flat, arms loosely out to the sides. This is a rig motion reference only. IGNORE in the video: face and mouth (never animate the face), camera drift, and any change of the held prop's size or shape. HELD PROP: the wooden board is parented to his hand bone and must stay in that hand the whole clip (do not drop it, do not animate it separately); keep it from passing through his body or the floor. Owner rules for every goblin: nothing goes through his body or the ground (when lying down, his back, head and limbs rest ON the floor, never under it); he falls in place where he stood (no sliding, root does not travel); weighty and cartoony, never floaty; poses read clearly from above and in front (board game camera); he faces straight forward (+Z) like the video. BASE POSE: "base_pose": "rest" (turns are relative to the straight front-facing rest pose, same as refs/goblin-grunt--front.jpg). This job REPLACES only the clip OH_Death ("replace": true). Do not touch, rename or remove any other clip. Smooth, even game animation.

animations.name: OH_Death
animations.description: Death, one-shot, from the whole video. Frames 0-15: standing in the start pose (same as frame 0 of OH_Idle), he wobbles dizzily side to side (fall-over f01-f05). Frames 15-40: knees buckle, hips drop straight down and he sits onto his bottom with legs out in front (f06-f11). Frames 40-62: he tips backwards and gently tumbles onto his back, arms swinging loosely up and out (f12 and lying-still f01-f02). Frames 62-72: small settle bounce as he lands flat on his back (lying-still f03). Frames 72-90: lies completely still on his back, arms loosely to the sides, legs relaxed (lying-still f04-f12). Hold the final pose: it is the last frame the game shows. Does NOT loop.
